lines.text: Why do I feel off today?
I'm a bit under the weather.

data.define: Used when you feel slightly ill or not well.

example.text: I'm a bit under the weather.

misuse.text: Don't say 'under the weather' about a storm.
misuse.why: It means feeling a little sick.

hook.text: Why do I feel off today?

publish.title: What does "under the weather" mean?
publish.value: Under the weather = I feel a little sick. Example: "I'm a bit under the weather." (casual English).
